stories.headline: Carney announces new auto strategy, scrapping EV mandate for rebates and emissions standards
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled a five-point plan to transform Canada's auto sector, scrapping the controversial Electric Vehicle Availability Standard and replacing it with $2.3 billion in consumer rebates for EVs under $50,000 and stricter tailpipe emissions regulations.
